theology: In ancient Greek myth, the proud hunter Narcissus wasted away by a still pool in Boeotia, unable to stop staring at his own reflection. The wood-nymphs and the mountain-echo Echo mourned him and came for the boy's body to burn it on a pyre. But where he had lain by the water they found no body at all -- only a small flower with white petals and a golden centre, growing at the edge of the pool. What is that flower still called?
trivia: In 2006 Nintendo released a small white home console that came with a slim wand-shaped controller. Sensors on top of the TV read the wand's motion, so players swung it in the air to hit tennis balls, bowl strikes, and throw punches in the pack-in game Wii Sports. Grandparents and little kids picked it up as easily as teenage gamers, and the machine sold out worldwide for months. Name the system.
